title: Kusanagi Nene — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Instrument Shop

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
They had the CD I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And thanks for coming with me, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No problem, Nene!
I'm glad they had what you were looking for!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. The lead in this musical has such a beautiful singing voice... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Isn't that Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, you're right!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Shiiho, surprise!
Good wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Otori?!
And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's been a while, Kusanagi...
What brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We came to get a CD Nene wanted!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we just found it, so we were thinking about going somewhere to hang out☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did you also come here to buy something, Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, nothing in particular.
I had some free time, so I decided to check out a few instruments.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wonder if it's the norm for people in bands to come check out instruments after school... I think that's pretty cool...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I was just about to head home since I've seen basically all of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we should all go somewhere and hang out together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, right now...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I tried to think of where we could go next while Nene looked at the CDs...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's when I remembered that this cute cafe on the way home that sells animal-shaped donuts just opened!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really want you two to see it because it's super adorable! So, let's go☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, did you hear?!
Shiho and I are in the same class!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You must've told me at least ten times by now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Because I'm super happy about it!
It's my chance to get to know her even better!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I can't say that makes me unhappy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Emu has a point. Hinomori always seems so calm...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And it was really fun when we got to sing together... I bet we'd get along if we were in the same class.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Although maybe I'm only thinking that since my class is full of extroverts...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, Kusanagi, I heard that Shiraishi and a couple of her teammates also attend Kamiyama High.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did you end up in the same class as any of them?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, both Shiraishi and Shinonome are in my class...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Then, you probably talk to them a lot, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, not really...
Their personalities are just too different from mine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's like trying to mix oil with water...
I doubt I'd be able to hold a long conversation or become friends with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you're overthinking things...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You and Otori seem plenty different to me, but you're close enough to hang out all the time after school and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I don't think personality has anything to do with it. Besides...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You, Shiraishi, and Shinonome all share a passion for singing. If anything, you would have a harder time not becoming friends.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
She's right, Nene!
You should have no problems getting along with them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm not so sure...
Still, Hinomori, your words were really convincing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I could learn a lot about music from Shiraishi and Shinonome if I found a way to get to know them better...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I am still having a hard time picturing it, but...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope we can become friends...
